spec.headline: Performance Marketing | Affiliate Economics | Attribution & Team Leadership
spec.headline_rationale: MyFitnessPal's creator role places weight on ROI, attribution, budget decisions, team leadership and automation. Emphasize the master's adjacent affiliate, social-channel and measurement experience honestly; do not label Dave a celebrity influencer specialist.
spec.summary: Performance marketer with experience in affiliate economics, consumer acquisition and team leadership. Analyzed lifetime value, affiliate commissions, discounts and promotion performance, and developed affiliate-program strategy with search and display creative. Led an eight-person e-commerce team in the fitness industry and managed paid channels including Meta, Instagram and TikTok. Brings attribution testing, automated cross-channel reporting and cost-benefit analysis to evaluating marketing investments, coordinating partners and improving how campaign performance is measured.
spec.factual_review: Read exact MyFitnessPal influencer job. Source E004/E102/E093/E030/E082/E009/E111; LifeSpan fitness employer verified. Celebrity/macro influencer negotiation, creator contract ownership, app subscription results and MMP expertise are unverified and not asserted. Existing saved thresholds and eligibility retained.
spec.tools_rationale: Master-supported campaign measurement, reporting and automation tools; no unsupported creator platform or mobile measurement vendor.
